verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no first-party documentation of an official Solid routing library (e.g., solid-router) or its integration; the only related mention is a community complaint that 'SolidStart routing... can be very slow with no workaround' (solid-comm-15), which is a single-tier community critique, not a vendor claim being contradicted. Since there's no first-party evidence to establish the capability, and the lone reference is negative, this falls short of even a partial delivery.
